senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Shinear, a part of Babylonia (v. Schr. KAT2, p. 118).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:20">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>למה נקרא שמה ש׳</he> why is Babylonia called Shinear?; v. <cite ref="N01007"><he>נָעַר</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 113b:14">Zeb. 113ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 113b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>למה … ש׳ שמנערת עשיריה</he> it is called Sh., because it shakes out its rich men (makes them poor); a. e.
